pywin32: Windows Win32 bindings; no Darwin implementation is expected.
pywin32-ctypes: Windows Credential Manager support used by keyring's Windows backend; macOS uses a different backend.
pythonnet: CLR bridge for the Windows pywebview renderer; the macOS Python UI needs the Cocoa backend instead.
clr-loader: CLR runtime loader used by pythonnet's Windows renderer path; not part of the Cocoa backend.
